full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case, in brief are that the present petitioners as pre-emptors filed Pre-emption Case No.25 of 1998 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Delduar, "Tangail for pre-empting the case land on the allegation that they are co-sharer in the case khatian by inheritance. The opposite party Nos. 2 and 3 without serving any notice upon them transferred 12 decimals of land appertaining to C.S. Khatian No.219 of Monza Shehratoil to the opposite party No.1, Yusof Ali Sikder, who is a stranger to the case jote and hence the ease.
